facts.fact: Cameroon's Director General of Customs says the CAMCIS customs information system has been in operation since April 2020, with its freight, clearance and revenue-collection modules launched.

CMR.note: ISO 27001 alignment of the customs system is a system built to a standard, not a national adoption.
A public-private partnership contract for CAMCIS is mentioned without an amount.
The customs recovery site is stated as not yet in service, with no place named.
